title: Exactness for the canonical slice-site open counit
statement: Let X be any topological space, U an open subset, and F an abelian sheaf. Let G be the sheafification of the slice-site extension-by-zero presheaf of F.over U [def-weil-pbc-site-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. Suppose a:G→F sends the sheafified direct-sum injection of every s∈F(V), for every inclusion V→U, to s. Let b:F→i_*i^{-1}F be the inverse-image adjunction unit for the closed complement inclusion i:X\U→X [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Then a composed with b is zero, and the resulting short complex G→F→i_*i^{-1}F is short exact [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: Put P equal to the slice extension presheaf, eta equal to its sheafification unit and k = eta followed by a. The hypothesis identifies k with the identity on each summand. At every open, k is injective: with an arrow to U, the unique direct-sum injection is a left inverse by DirectSum.induction_on; without an arrow the direct sum is zero. Mathlib stalkFunctor_map_injective_of_app_injective and the sheafification stalk isomorphism therefore give injectivity of the stalk of a. For x in U, represent a target germ on a neighbourhood contained in U by exists_le_germ_eq and lift its section using the unique summand and eta. This proves surjectivity and hence IsIso. Outside U every representative section belongs to an empty direct sum, giving a zero presheaf stalk; transfer this through stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso. This proves the open stalk cases directly without transporting the topological restriction construction.

Apply closedPushforwardAbelianStalks to the closed complement and the inverse image G. Its stalk is zero at x in U. For x outside U, set z=(x,hx). The germ formula of exists_inverseImage_stalk_iso_ab identifies the composite of the stalk of the adjunction unit with stalkPushforward with the hom of the inverse-image stalk isomorphism. Prove equality using stalk_hom_ext and stalkPushforward_germ. The closed-pushforward comparison is an isomorphism, so cancellation gives that the unit stalk is an isomorphism.

The composite stalk is zero: inside U its target is zero and outside U its source is zero. Apply section_ext in the target sheaf to each section of the composite to prove the composite itself is zero. Form the short complex. Inside U its first map is an isomorphism and its third object is zero; exact_iff_epi gives exactness, and the mono and epi conditions follow. Outside U its first object is zero and its second map is an isomorphism; use exact_iff_mono and the corresponding mono/epi conditions. Apply shortExact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_shortExact to conclude.
